free_tier.stated: Free plan: '5 GB storage' with 'Unlimited users - no team size limits'. Portals are free and self-service.

retention.stated: Retention: 'inactive Free accounts may be deleted after 40 days' — this is a documented data-loss clause and the binding constraint.

egress.terms: No egress meter on any plan; Drive files served from the portal. Not part of the pricing table.

tooling: Bitrix24 Drive mounts as a WebDAV network drive (documented for Windows/macOS); REST API also exposes disk.* methods. Third-party mounts exist (rclone via WebDAV, or OS-native WebDAV).
chaining: 5 GB x unlimited free portals, each with unlimited users. 100 portals = 500 GB. WebDAV means a plain `rclone copy` per portal — the most scriptable of the free-workspace KBs.

limits.value: Retention: 'inactive Free accounts may be deleted after 40 days

limits_note: per-object-cap: not published on the pricing page (Drive-specific cap unverified). Quota is per-portal, shared across Drive + CRM files + email attachments + call recordings — a mixed bucket. Retention: 'inactive Free accounts may be deleted after 40 days' — this is a documented data-loss clause and the binding constraint.
reliability_note: Inactive free portals are deleted after 40 days per Bitrix24's own blog, so an archive role requires periodic activity. Cannot attach external cloud storage to Drive.
